purpose: Qualification evidence for the intended Phase 3C execution environment, established under MR002_ExecutionSequencing_Direction_v1.1.json D-S7 step 2.
authority: Owner authorization 2026-08-11 — provision a QUALIFICATION-ONLY Phase 3C host with no validation-reader trust relationship and no validation/OOS access.

p10_outcome.reason: The bound evaluator image contains no numeric stack, so the in-image leg refused with numpy_unavailable. See MR002_EvaluatorImageRuntimeAdjudication_v1.0.json.
p10_outcome.note: The refusal is the control working. P10 declined to manufacture a numeric-runtime identity from an image that has no numeric runtime.

security_principal.naming_note: Deliberately NOT the placeholder string named in the validation-reader trust policy. Naming it 'mr002-phase3c-run-host-NOT-YET-PROVISIONED' would have made the reader assumable the instant the role existed (TRAP-NAME-1).
security_principal.p12_binding_note: Per D-S8, a future P12 binds THIS role identity plus the frozen runtime evidence — never the EC2 instance id.

boundary_proven.method: IAM policy simulation over the identity policy AND the sealed-store bucket policy. Deliberately not an attempted read.

instance.stopped_reason: Idle cost avoidance while the blocker is adjudicated at governance level. EBS, role, and instance profile preserved.

runtime_identity.host_leg_interpreter: Python 3.11.15 (AL2023 default python3 is 3.9, which cannot run the producer: datetime.UTC requires 3.11+)

identical: CPU model AMD EPYC 7R13, x86_64, AVX2 present
comparison_with_the_destroyed_qualified_.assessment: Same runtime family, same CPU model and instruction set. This is a requalification of the intended execution environment, not an equivalence proof — SR-HOST-1 governs what happens if it changes again.

frozen_thread_environment_applied.source: Transcribed from the frozen invocation recorded in MR002_HostRequalification_Submission_v1.0.md; NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS added because the producer's FROZEN_THREAD_ENV requires all five and treats unset as not frozen.

wp_b_resolver_evidence.resolution_path: WP-B Requirement-7 fail-closed resolver — the sole permitted path; no tag, local image, rebuild, or hand-supplied digest was used at any point
wp_b_resolver_evidence.note: This is the first end-to-end demonstration of the WP-B path at the container layer: the image was pulled by digest on the intended execution host and Docker independently reported the same digest. Requirement 7 nonetheless remains IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_C_R7_VERIFICATION; C-R7 requires a closed WP-F run, and WP-F is not authorized.

defect_found_and_corrected_during_qualif.symptom: The in-image leg crashed with IndexError before observing any binding.
defect_found_and_corrected_during_qualif.cause: REPO was computed at module scope as Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]. The in-image leg is bind-mounted at /tmp/mr002_capture.py, which has two parents, not three.
defect_found_and_corrected_during_qualif.why_44_tests_missed_it: Every test injected a fake runner, so the real _default_runner bind-mount contract was never executed and the module was never imported from outside the repository layout.
defect_found_and_corrected_during_qualif.correction: Extracted to a tested _repo_root() returning a non-existent sentinel outside the repo layout; host-leg constants are read only through _load_json/_sha256_file, which refuse on an unreadable file, so the fallback fails closed rather than substituting a default.
defect_found_and_corrected_during_qualif.owner_authorization: Approved 2026-08-11 as an amendment to the D-S1 WP-E freeze; does not weaken the 17-binding requirement and adds no escape hatch around the resolver.

boundary: Qualification evidence only. No credential released, no trust policy edited, no partition opened, no P10 produced. validation_authorization remains false at _rev 0; OOS remains under DENY; WP-F remains NOT AUTHORIZED.
